interactions.note: The epitope of nanobody Nb9F10 on the heterodimeric ABC exporter TmrAB, which consists of the Thermus thermophilus multidrug-resistance proteins A and B, in inward-facing narrow conformation under turnover conditions was determined from the cryo-EM 3D reconstruction of the complex to a resolution of 3.8 Å. The high-affinity conformationally non-selective nanobody NbF10, which forms a stable complex with the NBD of TmrB without affecting the transport rates, was used to break the pseudo-twofold symmetry of TmrAB.
